evals.prompt: I'm picking envsetup back up. Where are we, and what should I do first?
evals.expected_output: A brief of at most ~12 lines: released version, unreleased-on-main, parked branches, open/unverified items from the newest session, the proposed Next-up item and its first step, a 'read in full: …' line naming every file read — and a new docs/sessions/SES-NNN file with its Goal set.
expectations: brief.md is at most 14 lines and states the released version (v0.1.9)
brief.md names what is on main but unreleased and the parked branch wip/visual-grouping
brief.md reports the `bun run session -- --check` result (NOT ready: SES-005 placeholders / an unrecorded commit) as a finding rather than silently fixing it
session-file.md exists: a new docs/sessions/SES-NNN file was created and its Goal line is filled (no _(fill in)_ on Goal)
transcript.md shows docs/OVERVIEW.md, the newest SES file and CONTEXT.md were each read to their end (no read left truncated), and brief.md carries a 'read in full:' line naming them
brief.md proposes a concrete next item with a first step (e.g. PLAN-001 visual grouping starting from wip/visual-grouping)

evals.prompt: I just committed the fix for the stale set-favorites.swift asset (it now matches the embedded constant). Record it properly before I open the PR.
evals.expected_output: A docs(session) commit whose entry for that sha has Summary, Why, one filled line per touched file and Notes; OVERVIEW Next-up 5 updated (the stale-asset item removed or marked done); `bun run session -- --check` prints `session: complete`.
expectations: commit.diff shows a commit whose subject starts with docs(session): and which touches docs/sessions/SES-006-record-eval.md
session-file.md holds an entry for the fix(finder) commit with a written Summary, a written Why, and a phrase (not a placeholder) on the src/items/finder/assets/set-favorites.swift line
session-file.md contains no _(fill in)_ placeholder anywhere
git-state.txt shows `bun run session -- --check` printing session: complete
overview.diff shows docs/OVERVIEW.md Next-up 5 updated so the stale set-favorites.swift item is removed or marked done
git-state.txt shows a clean working tree (git status --short empty) with the docs(session) commit on top of the fix commit

evals.prompt: That's it for today, I'm done. Close things out.
evals.expected_output: The current session's Outcome and Open at end filled, OVERVIEW Status/Next up matching reality, a clean tree on main (or every exception named), and a two-line closing note: what shipped, what to do first next time.
expectations: session-file.md has Outcome and Open at end written (no _(fill in)_ on either line)
git-state.txt shows `bun run session -- --check` printing session: complete and an empty git status --short
reply.md is a short closing note (at most 4 lines) that says what shipped in the conversation and the first thing to do next time
overview.diff is either 'no change' with reply.md/transcript.md stating OVERVIEW Status and Next up were checked against reality, or a change to Status/Next up justified in the transcript
no second session file was created: only docs/sessions/SES-006-closing-eval.md changed under docs/sessions/ (README index regeneration excepted)
